summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Solar Dashboard MVP (Iter 1+2). All 18 pytest tests passed across /api/live, /api/config, /api/today, /api/history (1h/6h/12h/24h), /api/control/hoymiles, /api/control/trucki, /api/integrations/status, background poller, and demo_mode off fallback.

minor.issue: autarky_pct can exceed 100% (observed 137.8). Autarky (self-sufficiency) is by definition capped at 100%. Likely formula is self_consumption / consumption*100 but should be min(pv_used, consumption)/consumption*100, or rename to a different metric. Should be clamped or formula corrected.

action_items: Review/clamp autarky_pct calculation in /api/today (currently can return >100%).
Consider adding a /api/health or root /api endpoint for quick liveness checks (currently only resource endpoints exist).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 675 lines: borderline of the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (routes, device_fetchers, poller, models) before further feature growth.

Device fetchers (fetch_shelly/ahoy/trucki/victron) correctly fall back to mock generators when demo_mode=true. demo_mode off path also gracefully returns structured data with online=true in current preview (no real devices configured); consider verifying offline detection in real LAN scenarios.
autarky_pct logic should be clamped to [0,100] for UI safety.
seed_data_creation: Test toggles demo_mode off then restores back to true and changes shelly IP transiently then restores. No persistent test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is healthy at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api. All 18 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_solar_dashboard.py pass. Demo mode default ON; backend gracefully serves data when toggled off too. Background poller writes snapshots every ~15s (observed count incrementing). Only minor finding: autarky_pct may exceed 100% (math/logic). Use this test file as regression baseline for future iterations.
